home_p_15: When it comes to quality metalwork, we understand that every project requires precision, professionalism and commitment to quality. Maor Frames & Sons provides advanced framing solutions for the construction and real estate industry in central Israel and throughout the country. We specialize in framing work for construction projects, using advanced technologies and quality materials.
home_p_16: With many years of experience in the metalwork field, we provide comprehensive services from the planning stage to final installation. Our professional team consists of experienced metalworkers who understand the unique needs of each client and project.
home_p_17: We specialize in manufacturing custom metal frames for any type of construction project. Whether it's commercial, industrial or residential buildings, we provide precise solutions that meet all technical and design requirements.
home_p_18: Aluminum frames are the preferred choice for real estate developers looking for a combination of durability, aesthetics and efficiency. We provide quality aluminum frames for windows, doors, glass facades and additional systems, while maintaining high standards of quality and durability.
home_p_19: For industrial manufacturers, we provide special metal parts and industrial frames adapted to production lines and industrial products. Our team understands the specific requirements of the industry and provides solutions that meet the highest standards.
home_p_20: With many years of experience in the frames and metal field, we bring irreplaceable expertise. Every project is handled by experienced professionals who know the industry inside and out.
home_p_21: We use the most advanced equipment and technologies in the industry, which allows us to provide framing work with exceptionally high precision and quality.
home_p_22: We are committed to meeting schedules and providing reliable and professional service. Our clients know they can count on us at every stage of the project.
home_p_23: We use only the highest quality materials and maintain high standards at every stage of the work. Our quality speaks for itself.
home_p_24: Let's talk about your needs and find the perfect solution for your project. Our team is available for professional consultation without obligation.

about_h2_6: Want to Get to Know Us Better?
about_h3_7: Experience, Professionalism and Commitment to Quality
about_p_19: Maor Frames & Sons is a leading metalwork company in Israel, specializing in providing advanced frame and metal solutions for the construction and real estate industry. With many years of experience in the field, we provide comprehensive services to construction contractors, real estate developers and industrial manufacturers in the center of the country and throughout Israel.
about_p_20: Our metalwork company started as a small family business, and over the years has grown and developed into one of the leading companies in the field. We are proud of the reputation we have built over the years, based on quality, professionalism and reliability.
about_p_21: Our professional team consists of experienced metalworkers, engineers and skilled technicians who are committed to providing the best service to our customers. Every project, small or large, is handled with the same level of professionalism and attention to detail.
about_p_22: We believe that quality is the foundation for success. Every project we carry out undergoes strict quality control, and we use only raw materials from the leading brands in the industry. Our metalwork company maintains high standards at every stage of the work.
about_p_23: We understand that every customer and every project is unique. Therefore, we provide personal and customized service for each customer. Our team is available for professional consultation, accompanies the customer at every stage and maintains ongoing communication and complete transparency.
about_p_24: We understand the importance of meeting deadlines in construction projects. Our metalwork company is committed to delivering work on the agreed schedule, while maintaining quality and professionalism. We carefully plan each project and maintain efficient process management.
about_p_25: We invest in the most advanced equipment and technologies in the industry. Our metalwork company is equipped with advanced cutting and welding machines, CAD/CAM systems for precise planning, and additional tools that allow us to provide metalwork at the highest level.
about_p_26: The professional team of Maor Frames & Sons is our most important asset. Each team member brings with them many years of experience, professionalism and commitment to quality. We invest in continuous training of our team to ensure they are updated with the latest technologies and working methods.
about_p_27: Our metalworkers have extensive experience in all types of metalwork - from small projects to large industrial projects. They understand the unique needs of each customer and project, and provide creative and professional solutions.
about_p_28: Our engineering team specializes in planning and technical consulting, and accompanies our customers from the initial planning stage to final installation. We believe in teamwork and close cooperation with our customers.
about_p_29: With many years of experience in the field of frames and metal, we bring irreplaceable expertise. We have completed hundreds of successful projects for contractors, developers and manufacturers throughout the country.
about_p_30: Our metalwork company is equipped with the most advanced equipment in the industry - from CNC cutting machines to advanced welding systems. This allows us to provide metalwork with exceptionally high precision and quality.
about_p_31: We offer competitive prices without compromising on quality. We believe in providing real value to our customers, and maintain complete transparency in pricing.
about_p_32: We stand behind our work and provide full warranty on all our projects. If there is a problem, we are here to handle it quickly and professionally.
about_p_33: Our team is available for your service and committed to providing quick and efficient response. We understand that time is money, especially in construction projects, so we work efficiently and systematically.
about_p_34: We provide comprehensive service from consultation and planning, through manufacturing and installation, to maintenance and after-sales service. We are your partner throughout the entire journey.
about_p_35: We invite you to visit our metalwork shop, meet our team and see our equipment and capabilities. Contact us today to schedule a meeting.

services_h2_3: Aluminum Frames for Real Estate Developers
services_p_12: Our metalwork shop specializes in manufacturing custom metal frameworks for any type of construction project. We work with construction contractors and real estate developers in central Israel and throughout the country, providing precise solutions that meet all technical and design requirements.
services_p_13: Our framework services include detailed planning, precise manufacturing, and professional installation. We use high-quality raw materials and advanced welding technologies to ensure durability and long-lasting quality.
services_p_14: Aluminum frameworks are the preferred choice for real estate developers seeking a combination of durability, aesthetics, and energy efficiency. Our metalwork shop provides high-quality aluminum frameworks for windows, doors, glass facades, and additional systems.
services_p_15: We work with aluminum profiles from leading industry brands and perform framework services for construction projects of all types - from residential buildings to commercial and industrial structures.
services_p_16: For industrial manufacturers, our metalwork shop provides specialized metal parts and industrial frameworks adapted to production lines and industrial products. We understand the specific requirements of industry and provide solutions that meet the highest standards.
services_p_17: Our professional team specializes in complex framework projects, including specialized welding, precise metal bending, and custom part manufacturing. We work according to detailed plans and maintain absolute precision.
services_p_18: Safety is a top priority in every construction project. Our metalwork shop specializes in manufacturing and installing safety railings, metal stairs, and additional safety frameworks for construction projects.
services_p_19: We work in accordance with all Israeli standards and regulations, maintaining maximum quality and durability. Our railings are suitable for residential buildings, public buildings, and industrial sites.
services_p_20: Our metalwork shop manufactures and installs metal gates and fences for any purpose - from residential buildings to industrial sites. We offer a wide range of designs and styles, from classic to modern.
services_p_21: Our gates and fences combine durability, aesthetics, and functionality. We use quality materials and advanced manufacturing technologies to ensure a final product that meets all expectations.
services_p_22: Our metalwork shop also specializes in large and complex projects of steel structures and large frameworks. We work with contractors and developers on industrial, commercial, and public projects.
services_p_23: Our team is equipped with the knowledge, experience, and equipment required to perform framework services for large-scale construction projects. We provide professional and complete service from the planning stage through execution and on-site installation.
services_p_24: In addition to manufacturing new frameworks, our metalwork shop also offers renovation and repair services for existing frameworks. We handle all types of problems - from rust to mechanical damage.
services_p_25: Our team performs professional diagnosis, offers optimal solutions, and executes the work quickly and efficiently. We restore frameworks to their original appearance and function.
services_p_26: Our team is ready to help you with any project, large or small. Contact us today for professional consultation with no obligation.
